definitions.explanation: A temporary loss of electrical power in an area.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{停電|ていでん}になった。
examples.english: There was a power outage due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {停電|ていでん}は{三時間|さんじかん}{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: The power outage lasted three hours.

examples.japanese: {突然|とつぜん}{停電|ていでん}して、{真|ま}っ{暗|くら}になった。
examples.english: The power suddenly went out and it became pitch dark.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
・{停電|ていでん}する (there is a power outage)
・{停電|ていでん}になる (to become a blackout, for power to go out)
・{停電|ていでん}が{復旧|ふっきゅう}する (power is restored)

RELATED TERMS:
・{計画|けいかく}{停電|ていでん} (planned power outage, rolling blackout)
・{大規模|だいきぼ}{停電|ていでん} (large-scale blackout)
・{復旧|ふっきゅう} (restoration, recovery)

USAGE NOTE:
In Japan, {計画|けいかく}{停電|ていでん} (planned power outages) were implemented after the 2011 earthquake to manage electricity shortages.
